description: Telegram M2-M4 and v1.x per DESIGN §14: streaming assistant with drafts and Stop, answer_view (flat mode and Reviews wrap drafts too), follow-ups, media UX, feature cards and Hermes notifications (U12); rich views with classic fallback, live status card with own-PR activity, reminders, digest with merge rate by size class and the follower/star/merge/streak stats (DESIGN §14.19 items 1-3); PDF and voice UX on the FEAT-007 backend (§14.19 items 9-10); the opt-in private review mirror; Telegraph articles off by default (§14.19 item 18). The other §14.19 integrations are deferred (TRACEABILITY rows CR3-IH-*). Depends on FEAT-009. Plan: docs/PLAN.md (Telegram M2–M4 and v1.x: streaming assistant, rich views, digest, status card, review mirror, Telegraph). Requirement rows: docs/TRACEABILITY.md.
steps: Item 49: Streaming assistant (§14.12; rows DES-FR-13, DES-AC-36, CR2-7a, CR2-7h, CR2-7k, CR2-7l, CHAT-26, TGRW-9, CR3-D8, CR3-D9, CR3-D10, CR3-D21, CR3-U10, CR3-U12, CR3-AC-18, CR3-AC-19, CR3-AC-20, CR3-AC-22, CR3-AC-35, CR3-AC-48, CR3-AC-55, CR3-AC-59 (Stop part), CR3-AC-67 (/resume and U12 parts), CR3-BA-14, CR3-BA-15 (chat-turn wiring, album and test part; see phase2-build-plan.md item 49 Tests), CR3-BA-22, CR3-F6-2, CR3-M2, CR3-V-2, CR3-V-3, CR3-V-7, CR3-V-8, CR3-V-13, CR3-V-16, CR3-IH-9, CR3-IH-10). Drafts with Stop (`sendRichMessageDraft`/`sendMessageDraft`, `can_stop`), `stopped_message_generation` + `authorized_chat_only()`, `chat/{stream,drafts,md2blocks,followups,answer_view}.py` (flat mode and Reviews wrap drafts too), sources and footer, follow-ups, albums and reactions, `/new /title /memory`, feature cards and Hermes notifications (U12), assistant-unavailable states, the PDF and voice UX of §14.12.5 on the item 37 backend. `ALLOWED_UPDATES` gains `stopped_message_generation`, authorized by `auth.authorized_chat_only()` (TGRW-9, U10); it lands here, with the Stop handler that needs it, not in FEAT-005.

Item 50: Rich views and status (§14.11.11, §14.13.4; rows CR3-AC-42, CR3-AC-64, CR3-BA-9, CR3-M3, CR4-3c, CR3-IH-1, CR3-IH-2, CR3-IH-3). Rich explorer/file/interdiff/tests/assistant behind `auto` with classic fallback, S10/S11 live status card and drafted replies, reminders (`/remind`, `ossbot_reminder_create`), daily and weekly digest with merge rate by size class and the §14.19 item 1 stats (followers, stars, merges, streak) from gatekeeper GitHub reads, own-PR activity on the status card (§14.19 item 2); migration `0006_telegram_m2.sql` (`digest_runs`, `reminders`, `review_mirror`, `telegraph_pages`).

Item 51: Review mirror, opt-in (§14.11.14, ADR-0019 C; rows ADR-0019, CR3-AC-24, CR3-U5, CR3-U9, CR3-M4, CR3-V-9). `review_mirror.py`, `review_mirror_writer.py`, `ossctl review-mirror enable|disable|status|purge`, setup-secrets optional key; off by default.

Item 52: Telegraph, off by default (§14.12.8; rows CR3-v1.x, CR3-D17, CR3-U9, CR3-U11, CR3-AC-27, CR3-AC-28, CR3-AC-65, CR3-AC-68, CR3-BA-10, CR3-BA-19, CR3-BA-20, CR3-F6-3, CR3-F6-4, CR3-V-11, CHAT-36, CR3-IH-18). `telegraph.py`, `telegraph_writer.py`, gatekeeper-only `telegraph` egress category rendered only when enabled, `ossctl telegraph setup|rotate`, `/articles`.

Item 53: Close-out FEAT-010: redeploy, hermetic suites, live owner-only checks (a streamed sourced answer, Stop, a food photo through Telegram, an album), TRACEABILITY and VERIFICATION, commit (rows CR3-IH-4).
